sections.content: [Placeholder passage text for Alexander Henderson. The passage covers the life of Canadian photographer Alexander Henderson: born in Scotland in 1831, father was a farmer; trained as an accountant; emigrated to Canada in 1855; grew up near Press estate; collaborated with Notman in 1865 experiment; opened photographic studio in 1866; people bought his photos because equipment was heavy; sold photos as gifts or souvenirs; worked for Intercolonial Railway after Montreal-Halifax line was finished; travelled in Quebec and Ontario in 1870s-1880s by canoe; worked for CPR in 1885 photographing the mountains and Rogers Pass.]
